column3: With respect to The Common Place Mortgage Loan (2.5%), the mortgaged property was the subject of a development agreement between a sponsor affiliate, as developer, and the Village of Ashwaubenon, WI whereby the sponsor received a $1,750,000 Tax Increment Financing incentive payment for use in project costs, to be repaid over a 15 year period from the difference of fully-assessed property taxes and the 2022 base-year property tax amount. For 2024 the fully-assessed property tax is $229,699 and the 2022 base-year amount is $24,748. The borrower’s sponsor provided a personal guaranty to the Village for any payment shortfall and for the performance of all related obligations. The Village executed an estoppel in connection with loan origination confirming that all related development obligations had been completed. The loan documents provide that the borrower and guarantor have personal liability for losses related to breach or violation of the development agreement, among other things.
